facts.value: Provides the match-end presentation callback installed for special encounter variant 3. Recognized stage kinds select up to three FighterKind entries: Yoshi, Link, Kirby, Pikachu with unlocked Pichu/Jigglypuff additions, Popo/Nana, or Male/Female Wire Frames. facts.rationale: The same decision field is submitted to campaign record updaters, and the called helper performs arithmetic rather than converting time units.
facts.value: Consumes departing DebugGameOverData, mutable campaign state, persistent player settings, and a campaign selector. It copies decision.x18 into run.xC.x14 and publishes that value through gm_801623FC. On termination, decision.x4 and the run character feed the current campaign's record updater before trophy, challenger and menu routing. On continue, it stores lbTime_8000AEC8((u32) decision.x4, 1) in run.xC.x18, restores configured stocks, increments the byte-sized continue counter through lbTime_8000AF74, and schedules run.x0.mode. The x4-to-x18 operation is saturating addition to the submitted score/progress value, not elapsed-time conversion.

evidence.why: Both decision branches and guarded menu selection.

facts.rationale: Corrects the elapsed-time claim and retains the exceptional no-candidate routing guard and exact arithmetic.
facts.value: After publishing decision.x18, branches on decision.xC. Nonzero continues the run: decision.x4 is incremented with unsigned saturation and stored in run.xC.x18, configured stocks are restored, the continue counter is incremented with byte-range saturation, and the saved campaign scene is scheduled. Zero ends the run: the current campaign record is updated, trophy and unlock processing runs, and a returned challenger candidate selects Challenger Approaching. With no candidate, the menu is selected only if gm_80173754(1, run.x0.slot) returns zero.

facts.value: Every invocation unconditionally marks all three teammate descriptors vacant by setting ckind to CHKIND_NONE while preserving every other field. The teammate constructor skips each descriptor until another routine assigns a non-sentinel character kind; this reset does not directly alter live player slots.

evidence.why: Unconditional attribute population and requested-count return.

facts.rationale: Adds the selector's exceptional exhaustion path and preserves the distinction between requested and successful generation.
facts.value: Requested ally count follows flag priority: 0x20 yields zero; otherwise 0x10 yields three minus occupied preset slots; otherwise 0x02 yields two; otherwise zero. Each requested slot receives the selector result and callback attributes, with null callbacks supplying zero. If the eligible character pool is exhausted, CHKIND_NONE is stored but attribute callbacks still run and generation continues. Remaining records through index two have only their character byte invalidated. The return is the requested count, not the number of populated characters successfully selected.

evidence.why: Signed identifier, unsigned quantity and table extent.
Exact signature and all return paths.

facts.rationale: The exact storage and return types expose an ambiguity omitted by the previous success/failure description.
facts.value: Signature s8 gm_8017E280(u16 trophy_id, u32 increment). The fixed twelve-entry table stores identifiers as s16 and quantities as u8, with identifier -1 denoting vacancy. Successful updates or insertions return the narrowed quantity through s8; the no-capacity branch also returns -1. Consequently a successful stored quantity of 255 has the same returned value as failure, and quantities 128–255 return negative values on the target.

evidence.why: Narrow signed key and byte quantity.
Ordered searches, narrowing and return ambiguity.

facts.rationale: Preserves update-first ordering and capacity behavior while documenting numeric-domain and sentinel exceptions visible in canonical types.
facts.value: Searches all twelve entries for a matching identifier before searching for the first entry whose signed identifier is -1. A match adds increment into the u8 quantity, wrapping rather than saturating; insertion narrows both identifier and quantity. With no match and no vacant entry, state is unchanged and -1 is returned. Successful quantities also undergo s8 conversion, so -1 is not an unambiguous failure indication. The u16 input is compared with a promoted s16 stored key: high-bit identifiers do not behave as ordinary nonnegative trophy IDs, and inserting 0xFFFF leaves the identifier equal to the vacancy sentinel. Normal observed producers submit trophy IDs with increment one.

evidence.why: Allies, campaign queries and deferred trophies.

facts.rationale: Replaces a historical PR-derived description of Adventure stage-table accessors with the current translation unit's canonical functionality.
facts.value: Contains shared regular-one-player campaign support: Master Hand/Crazy Hand encounter control, special-stage callbacks and Adventure fighter preloading, campaign reset and Game Over/clear/result processing, callback-driven match construction, randomized ally generation and teammate initialization, campaign-state queries, and a twelve-entry deferred trophy-acquisition accumulator.
